reviewer: Antigravity Studio Agent (verified against full HyperFrames MP4 render and snapshot contact sheets)

criteria.question: One clear focal point per beat; reading order is obvious.
criteria.notes: Every beat pairs a high-contrast header with a single dominant hero element: spline peak/plunge in Scene 1, radial liquidation gauge in Scene 2, retail flow meter in Scene 3, and -$2.4T monument takeaway in Scene 4.

criteria.question: Type roles are consistent; sizes respect the floor; no orphans or awkward breaks.
criteria.notes: Playfair Display serif for headers (42px), JetBrains Mono for telemetry/kickers (19px), and 84px monument callout. Strict readability floor enforced.

criteria.question: Layouts are intentional in every format (not stretched or cropped landscape).
criteria.notes: Purpose-built for 720x1280 portrait 9:16 vertical reels with top progress bar, clear middle hero stage (70%+ utilization), and anchored bottom takeaway cards.

criteria.question: Holds match reading time; rhythm varies; nothing drags or rushes.
criteria.notes: Synchronized to measured speech timestamps in timeline.json. Multi-beat scene structure introduces new visual developments every 2-3 seconds.

criteria.question: All text is legible at delivery size with sufficient contrast.
criteria.notes: All text passes WCAG AA contrast checks (38/38 checks pass in HyperFrames linter); charcoal #111827 on ivory #FBFBFA delivers 15.4:1 contrast ratio.

criteria.question: Palette and texture follow the chosen style system and direction.
criteria.notes: Follows editorial-light style system: warm ivory canvas (#FBFBFA), deep vermilion accent (#DC2626), marigold amber (#D97706), and charcoal typography (#111827).

criteria.question: Each transition carries meaning or continuity; none are decorative filler.
criteria.notes: Employs composable spatial transitions (push up, push left, wipe) connecting crash momentum to liquidation unwind and retail bottleneck.

criteria.question: Motion vocabulary is consistent across scenes.
criteria.notes: Consistent visual language combining geometric spline curves, mechanical dials, particle vectors, and bold financial typography.

criteria.question: No repetitive looping filler or motion without purpose.
criteria.notes: Every movement advances the explanation: spline traces price plunge, gauge visualizes debt loss, particles show order volume, strikethrough shatters intervention.

criteria.question: No unintended static stretches; intentional holds are marked.
criteria.notes: Continuous virtual camera drift (1.0 -> 1.035) and micro-beat animations eliminate static visual freezes. Final takeaway holds cleanly for 2.2s.

criteria.question: No accidental overlaps, clipping or safe-area violations.
criteria.notes: Zero layout collisions or clipping detected by HyperFrames linter across all 15 sample frames.

criteria.question: Clear opening, progression and ending; the last frame holds long enough.
criteria.notes: Complete dramatic arc: Bubble Euphoria -> Margin Trap -> Herd Contagion -> Broken Intervention & Monument Loss (-$2.4T).

pass_rule: Every criterion scored 1-5 with evidence (frame or contact-sheet paths); all >= 3 and mean >= 3.5.
